# Renovation permits in Sicily, explained simply

“Which procedure is needed?” is a question to ask after describing the work and identifying the property. Simply calling works “renovation” or “bathroom refurbishment” is not enough: changes to structures, elevations, intended use, and context can change the classification. This guide offers general orientation to be verified with the assigned qualified technician, not an authorization to begin.

## Contents

- Why national and regional regulations coexist in Sicily
- Distinguishing between CILA, SCIA, and building permits
- Constraints and additional requirements
- Who to contact in Cefalù
- Frequently Asked Questions

## A national framework with Sicilian transposition

D.P.R. 380/2001 is the national unified text on building. The Sicilian regional law L.R. 16/2016 provides for its transposition, with some articles incorporated dynamically and others modified at the regional level. This is why a generic table found online is not sufficient to establish the procedure for a home in Cefalù.

The consulted regional coordinated text declares its validity as of 28 February 2025. It is not presented as a certification of the entire framework in effect as of November 2026: before finalizing this guide, the reviewer must check subsequent updates and applicable municipal forms.

## CILA: a sworn communication, not a issued permit

CILA stands for sworn communication of commencement of works (comunicazione di inizio lavori asseverata). The national reference is article 6-bis; in Sicily, it is also necessary to read article 3 of L.R. 16/2016, which amends articles 6 and 6-bis. The sworn declaration involves the professional's responsibility and does not transform the communication into a prior favorable verification of every aspect of the property.

Not all interior works are automatically covered by a CILA. Structural parts, systems, other sectoral regulations, and the characteristics of the intervention must be evaluated before choosing the procedure.

## SCIA: a notice with prerequisites to be verified

SCIA stands for certified notice of commencement of activity (segnalazione certificata di inizio attività). Article 22 of the national text regulates the categories included; in Sicily, it must be read alongside article 10 of L.R. 16/2016, which incorporates articles 22 and 23 with modifications. The updated regional framework and the actual configuration of the works remain decisive. It is not a procedure interchangeable with the CILA for convenience.

There are also instances of SCIA as an alternative to the building permit, regulated separately. One cannot automatically transfer prerequisites or methods from one procedure to another. This guide does not indicate automatic start times: the professional must confirm them along with the presence of all necessary documents.

## Building permit (Permesso di costruire): not for every job, not avoidable by choice

The national article 10 concerns interventions subject to a building permit; in Sicily, it must be compared with article 5 of L.R. 16/2016 and relevant updates. The necessity of the title depends on the works and the context, not on the value of the quote or the “turnkey” commercial formula.

Even free building works (edilizia libera) remain subject to applicable sectoral rules. “That building title is not required” does not mean “any intervention can be done without checks”.

## Building titles and authorizations are separate matters

Landscape protection and cultural heritage protection require their own verifications. D.Lgs. 42/2004 and D.P.R. 31/2017 are references for understanding why there may be authorizations or excluded/simplified categories: they do not attest that your intervention is exempt. It is necessary to read the relevant attachments, local regulations, and acts related to the asset.

In the historic center, neither an absolute prohibition nor a generalized authorization is presumed. In 2026, the Municipality signaled the adoption of a provincial landscape plan: its application to the property must be verified with maps and requirements. Structures, seismic regulations, safety, and other possible constraints are not automatically absorbed by the building filing.

## Municipal contact and questions to prepare

The Municipality of Cefalù directs you to the SUE (Unified Building Desk) for electronic submission of building files and to the Private Building – Urban Planning Office for relevant activities. The professional must verify current methods and attachments directly with the office. Do not submit a file based solely on this guide.

Ask the professional to clarify in writing: classification of the works; documents to be acquired; applicable title or communication; additional acts; conditions to start; final documents. For work in other municipalities, verify the actual competent office.

To define the operational perimeter, you can consult the [construction services](/en/services) and write to [Marenetto Build](mailto:info@marenetto.com). The quote provided after an on-site visit does not replace the appointment of a professional nor the administrative investigation.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Does the CILA also authorize works on a protected property?

The building communication does not replace the documents possibly required by heritage or landscape protection. The professional must verify if they are needed and when they must be acquired.

### Can I decide the procedure by looking at photographs of the work?

Photographs can help describe the intervention, but they do not by themselves document the legitimate status, structures, and constraints. Choosing the procedure requires professional verification.

### Can the contractor guarantee the obtaining of a permit?

This guide does not offer such a guarantee. Roles, assignments, and administrative activities must be defined; the outcome depends on the prerequisites and the competent authorities.

## Sources and limitations

Documentary consultation November 25, 2026: Normattiva, D.P.R. 380/2001, articles 6-bis, 10, and 22; Regione Siciliana, L.R. 16/2016, articles 1, 3, 5, and the transposition framework, and circular 1/2025 of May 28, 2025; Municipality of Cefalù, SUE, competent office, and landscape notice; D.Lgs. 42/2004 and D.P.R. 31/2017. The register distinguishes norms read, indices consulted, and update limits. It is an informational framework, not a professional validation of the procedure: applicable regulations, updates, constraints, and necessary deeds for the property remain to be verified with the assigned technician and competent offices.
